+import argparse as _argparse
+import re as _re
+import sys as _sys
+from collections import Counter as _Counter
+
+
+def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    words = _re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+", text.lower())
+    return [word.strip("'") for word in words if word.strip("'")]
+
+
+def top_words(text: str, n: int = 10) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
+    if n < 1:
+        raise ValueError("n must be at least 1")
+
+    counts = _Counter(tokenize(text))
+    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:n]
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:

@'
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

path = pathlib.Path('wordfreq.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('wordfreq', path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
assert {name for name in vars(module) if not name.startswith('_')} == {'tokenize', 'top_words', 'main'}
assert module.tokenize('Hello, world! Hello.') == ['hello', 'world', 'hello']
assert module.tokenize("'''") == []
assert module.tokenize("don't stop rock'n'roll") == ["don't", 'stop', "rock'n'roll"]
assert module.tokenize("'quoted' a-b x1 2y") == ['quoted', 'a', 'b', 'x1', '2y']
assert module.top_words('b b a a c', 2) == [('a', 2), ('b', 2)]
assert module.top_words('z z z y', 10) == [('z', 3), ('y', 1)]
assert module.top_words('', 5) == []
try:
    module.top_words('x', 0)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('top_words must reject n < 1')

for args, input_text, code, stdout, stderr_required in [
    (['-n', '2'], 'b b a a c', 0, 'a\t2\nb\t2\n', False),
    ([], '', 0, '', False),
    (['-n', '0'], 'x', 2, '', True),
    (['-n', 'abc'], 'x', 2, '', True),
    (['somefile.txt'], 'x', 2, '', True),
    (['--top', '1'], 'b a', 0, 'a\t1\n', False),
]:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(path), *args], input=input_text, text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode == code, (args, result.returncode, result.stderr)
    assert result.stdout == stdout, (args, repr(result.stdout))
    assert bool(result.stderr) == stderr_required, (args, repr(result.stderr))
print('All wordfreq checks passed.')
'@ | python -
